permissionEvidence.questionSummary: Whether the dictionary data may be used in a commercial app, bundled for offline lookup, and whether anything beyond the MIT notice is required.

bookRules.daily: Positive frq <= 3000 OR positive bnc <= 3000, with a nonempty Chinese definition. This is a frequency-rule book, not a CEFR or official examination list.
bookRules.high-school: Upstream gk tag, with a nonempty Chinese definition.
bookRules.cet4: Upstream cet4 tag, with a nonempty Chinese definition.
bookRules.cet6: Upstream cet6 tag, with a nonempty Chinese definition.
bookRules.ielts: Upstream ielts tag, with a nonempty Chinese definition.

limitations: The complete pinned base CSV is not every English word or the separate 3.4-million-entry ECDICT release.
Phonetic values preserve upstream transcription, including older conventions; they are not asserted to be modern regional IPA.
English and Chinese definition lines are not assumed to align by ordinal.
No usable examples or audio are supplied by this CSV.
Exam tags are upstream classifications, not a verified complete current official examination syllabus.
Upstream README describes mixed historical sources; maintainer distribution permission does not constitute a per-entry third-party rights audit.
